prompt:
A proton enters a uniform magnetic field of flux density $0.25\ \text{T}$ with a speed of $2.0 \times 10^{6}\ \text{m s}^{-1}$, moving perpendicular to the field.

**(a)** Explain why the proton moves in a circle. **[2]**

**(b)** Calculate the radius of the circle. **[2]**

**(c)** Show that the time for one revolution does not depend on the speed of the proton, and calculate it. **[2]**
markscheme:
**(a)** The magnetic force $qvB$ is always perpendicular to the velocity ✓, so it changes the direction but not the speed, and acts as a centripetal force of constant size ✓

**(b)** $qvB = \tfrac{mv^2}{r} \Rightarrow r = \tfrac{mv}{qB}$ ✓ $= \tfrac{1.67 \times 10^{-27} \times 2.0 \times 10^{6}}{1.60 \times 10^{-19} \times 0.25} \approx 0.084\ \text{m}$ ✓

**(c)** $T = \tfrac{2\pi r}{v} = \tfrac{2\pi m}{qB}$, which contains no $v$ ✓; $T = \tfrac{2\pi \times 1.67 \times 10^{-27}}{1.60 \times 10^{-19} \times 0.25} \approx 2.6 \times 10^{-7}\ \text{s}$ ✓

prompt: An electron is accelerated from rest through a potential difference of $250\ \text{V}$. What is its kinetic energy?
An electron moves in a circular path in a uniform magnetic field. The magnetic flux density is doubled. What happens to the kinetic energy of the electron and the radius of its path?
markscheme: **A.** The magnetic force does no work, so $E_k$ is unchanged; $r = mv/qB$ halves when $B$ doubles.

prompt: Two long parallel wires carry currents $I$ and $2I$ in the same direction and attract each other with force per unit length $F$. Both currents are doubled and the separation is doubled. What is the new force per unit length?
markscheme: **B.** $F/L \propto I_1I_2/r$: the currents give a factor of 4 and the separation divides by 2.

prompt:
Singly charged positive ions pass through a region where a uniform electric field of $4.0 \times 10^{4}\ \text{V m}^{-1}$ is perpendicular to a uniform magnetic field of $0.20\ \text{T}$. Both fields are perpendicular to the ions’ velocity.

**(a)** Explain why only ions of one speed pass through undeflected and calculate that speed. **[3]**

**(b)** The undeflected ions then enter a region containing only a magnetic field of $0.20\ \text{T}$ and move in a semicircle of radius $0.21\ \text{m}$. Determine the mass of an ion. **[3]**
markscheme:
**(a)** The electric force $qE$ and magnetic force $qvB$ act in opposite directions ✓; they balance only when $v = E/B$, any other speed gives a resultant force ✓; $v = \tfrac{4.0\times10^4}{0.20} = 2.0\times10^5\ \text{m s}^{-1}$ ✓

**(b)** $r = \tfrac{mv}{qB}$ ✓; $m = \tfrac{qBr}{v} = \tfrac{1.6\times10^{-19} \times 0.20 \times 0.21}{2.0\times10^5}$ ✓ $\approx 3.4\times10^{-26}\ \text{kg}$ ✓
